notes.standings: Captured source-page snapshots; archived standings may reflect the published period, not a formal final audit.
notes.rates: Team PPG is points per game. Roster scoring medians are per published player-game, not team-scoring predictions.
notes.prior: Prior scoring uses only earlier source league IDs and exact published player IDs, excluding flagged IDs.
notes.ratings: 2026/27 Elo prototype is within a single league night only; cannot compare across nights or authorize transfers.
notes.identity: Roster overlap is a review candidate, not proof of team continuity or same person where IDs change.
notes.eligibility: No signed game-sheet participation or official eligibility conclusions.
notes.privacy: No player names, source player IDs, individual profiles, WhatsApp responses or private team data exported.
